steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Wave eqn: v = fλ; phase difference Deltaφ = 2piDeltax/λ = 2pift

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Superposition: y_total = y₁ + y₂; constructive: Deltaφ = 2npi; destructive: Deltaφ = (2n+1)pi

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Standing waves: nodes (A=0) at fixed ends; antinodes (A=max) at λ/4 intervals

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Double slit: fringe spacing w = λD/s; single slit: first minima at a sinθ = λ

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Light of wavelength 500 nm passes through double slits 0.2 mm apart. Fringes observed on screen 2.5 m away. Find fringe spacing --- Solution: w = λD/s = (500x10⁻⁹ x 2.5) / (0.2x10⁻^3) = 6.25x10⁻^3 m = 6.25 mm

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: A wave travels at 340 m/s with frequency 170 Hz. Find wavelength | Two coherent sources 1.5 mm apart produce fringes 4 mm apart at 3 m. Find λ | Find critical angle for glass-air interface (n_glass = 1.5)
